plugins_publish_intro: Build a plugin with the NAEOS Plugin SDK, then publish it to the registry.
plugins_publish_official: Official plugins are maintained by the NAEOS Foundation and marked with the badge above. Reference implementations live in examples/plugins/. Want your plugin listed as official? Open a PR against the registry data.
hero_subtitle: From a single YAML spec, NAEOS generates complete projects — code, CI/CD, docs, deployment manifests, and AI context — across 5 languages and 6 AI platforms. Stop scaffolding. Start shipping.
section_what_is_desc: NAEOS is an engineering runtime that reads your YAML/JSON specification, builds a complete internal model of your system (NEIR), then orchestrates the entire engineering lifecycle — parse, validate, generate, compile, and export. Your spec stays the single source of truth from first prototype to production.
section_cta_desc: Install NAEOS in one command and generate your first project in under a minute.
feature_pipeline_desc: 11-stage DAG pipeline from spec to shipped code. Each stage is observable, cacheable, and extensible via plugins. Inspect every transformation from YAML to artifact.
feature_compiler_desc: Feed your architecture directly into coding assistants. AI context bundles give Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Codex, and OpenCode full system awareness — no more repeated prompting.
feature_generator_desc: Production-ready code in Go, TypeScript, Python, Java, and Rust. Per-language adapters generate idiomatic project structures, tests, and dependency files out of the box.
feature_neir_desc: A canonical model of your entire system — project structure, architecture, modules, services, APIs, infrastructure, and security policies. NEIR is the bridge between your intent and every generated artifact.
feature_governance_desc: Enforce architecture rules before they hit production. Policy engine with 7 operators, RBAC, full audit trails, and artifact review. Catch violations during generation, not deployment.
feature_marketplace_desc: Publish, discover, and install industry profiles and plugins. 5 built-in profiles (SaaS, AI Agent, FinTech, Healthcare, Government) plus a growing community registry.

home_use_case_serverless_desc: Describe event sources and function chains. Generate deployable Python and TypeScript handlers with IAM policies, event mappings, and framework configuration included.
home_use_case_ai_desc: Compile your architecture into AI instruction sets. Your coding assistants start with full context — module structure, dependencies, API contracts — without copying READMEs into every prompt.
home_use_case_governance_desc: Prevent architecture drift across teams. RBAC, audit trails, and a policy engine with 7 operators catch violations during generation — not after deployment.

home_testimonial_one: We replaced three code generators and a wiki with one NAEOS spec. Scaffolding a new Go + TypeScript service now takes seconds instead of hours.
home_testimonial_two: The AI context bundles are a game changer. Claude Code understands our full architecture without me pasting README excerpts into every single prompt.
home_testimonial_three: We migrated 12 services to NAEOS. The governance engine flagged three architecture violations during generation — caught them before they ever hit a PR.

mk_problem_desc: Hand-writing boilerplate across five languages, keeping READMEs in sync with APIs, re-prompting AI assistants with architecture context — it compounds on every service you ship. Most teams spend weeks wiring projects before writing a single line of business logic.
mk_problem_item1: Boilerplate drift between languages and repos
mk_problem_item3: Docs, CI, and deployment configs maintained by hand
mk_solution_desc: NAEOS reads a single YAML/JSON specification, builds a canonical internal model (NEIR), and orchestrates the full engineering lifecycle — code, tests, CI/CD, deployment manifests, docs, and AI context — all traceable from intent to implementation.
mk_solution_item1: Single source of truth: the spec is the system
mk_solution_item3: AI context bundles for every assistant

mk_how_step1_desc: Declare modules, services, architecture, and infrastructure in one YAML file. The spec is the single source of truth — no code yet, just intent.

mk_how_step3_desc: Production-ready projects in Go, TypeScript, Python, Java, or Rust — plus CI/CD, Docker/K8s manifests, docs, and AI context for 6 assistants.
